title: Symmetric Lottery Tickets
brief: A lottery runs a promotion for ticket numbers that read the same from left to right as from right to left when written in decimal. The ticket service stores the number as a signed integer.
Implement isMirrorNumber(x), where x is the ticket number, and return true if its decimal form reads the same in both directions and false otherwise.
